Counsel for Applicant :- Smriti Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.9 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504,
304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kheri, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was marred to the applicant around 6 years ago and a child, who is 2 years old, was also born.
Subsequently, the applicant used to harass her and on 29.12.2023, an information was received that the deceased had committed suicide.

The cause of death as per the postmortem report is due to ante mortem hanging Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31268584/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 and ante mortem injury and apart from the ligature mark, four ante mortem injuries were also observed.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that there is no specific statement against the applicant to suggest that soon before her death, the victim was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to any demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 08.02.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Dinesh Kumar be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
